title: TD Change Map Schema
description: Schema for validating change map artifacts in Docs/td/. Declares intended modifications with doctrine alignment and rationale. Change maps are commitment devices - they force explicit declaration before modification.

start.description: Start line number (1-indexed). Only set if actually inspected.

end.description: End line number (1-indexed). Only set if actually inspected.

inspection_status.description: How thoroughly this range has been inspected.

path.description: Relative path to the file from repository root.

action.description: Type of modification planned for this file.

rationale.description: Why this file needs to be modified.

line_ranges.description: Specific line ranges to be modified. Must be empty if not inspected.

symbols.description: Symbols within this file affected by the change.

depends_on.description: Other files that must be modified before this one.

risk.description: Risk level of modifying this file.

verification_required.description: Verification commands or checks required after modification.

rule.description: The doctrine rule being aligned with.

reference.description: Path to the doctrine document containing this rule.

waiver_requested.description: Whether a waiver has been requested for this rule.

waiver_approved.description: Who approved the waiver, if granted.

verified_by.description: Validation script or method that verified compliance.

task_id.description: The task ID this change map belongs to.

epic_id.description: The epic ID this change map belongs to, if different from task_id.

affected_surface.description: High-level surface or component being modified (e.g., 'SubprocessPooling', 'TierValidation', 'MediaCore').

action.description: Overall action type for this change map.

summary.description: Brief summary of the planned changes.

description.description: Detailed description of the planned changes.

files.description: Files to be modified with their planned actions.

doctrine_alignment.description: Explicit alignment of planned changes with doctrine rules.

verification_profiles.description: Verification profile IDs that must pass after these changes.

expected_proof.description: Proof artifacts expected to be generated by these changes.

risk.description: Overall risk level of this change map.

open_questions.description: Open questions that must be resolved before implementation.

non_goals.description: Explicit list of what this change map does NOT cover.

created_at.description: When this change map was created.

updated_at.description: When this change map was last updated.

approval_date.description: When this change map was approved.

notes.description: Free-form notes about this change map.
